parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports all other components such as the door, shelves, and base.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the entire cabinet together.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood for stability and load distribution.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and its contents, ensuring balance and stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a front panel made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges and equipped with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower shelf is a horizontal plywood panel inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper shelf is another horizontal plywood panel positioned above the lower shelf.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for smaller or lighter items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.
